statBlock.name: Banderhobb
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A shadow-walking kidnapper that can track a creature or object from a fragment of it.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and the languages of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Traits: Resonant Connection. While carrying a piece of a creature or object, such as a hair or splinter, the banderhobb knows the most direct route to its source if it is within 1 mile.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tongue attack. Shadow Step can replace one of those attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage and grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 16). That creature is restrained until the grapple ends. While it remains grappled, the banderhobb cannot Bite or use Tongue against another target.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 16 Strength save, the target is pulled into a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
Shadow Step. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.
Swallow. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the banderhobb has grappled. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, swallows the creature, and ends the grapple. The creature is blinded and restrained while swallowed, with total cover against attacks and effects from outside the banderhobb. It takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the banderhobb's turns. If this damage drops it to 0 hit points, the damage stops and the creature becomes stable.
Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. The banderhobb can regurgitate it at any time while not incapacitated, without spending an action. It also regurgitates the creature when it dies. The creature lands prone in a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 56.

statBlock.name: Baphomet
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A demon lord who hunts through a labyrinth with a massive blade called Heartcleaver.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical.
sections.Traits:
Labyrinthine Recall. Baphomet remembers every path he has taken and is immune to the Maze spell.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Baphomet fails a saving throw, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Gore, and one Heartcleaver attack. Use Frightful Presence as part of the same action.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d6 + 10) piercing damage. Add 16 (3d10) piercing damage if Baphomet moved at least 10 ft. directly toward the target immediately before the hit. A creature hit by Gore makes a DC 25 Strength save, falling prone and being pushed up to 10 ft. away on a failure.
Heartcleaver. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any number of creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of Baphomet. Each makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or becomes frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if it has line of sight to Baphomet. A success ends the effect. A creature that succeeds on any save or whose fear ends becomes immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 18). Material components are waived.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Dominate Beast, Maze, Wall of Stone.
1/day. Teleport.
sections.Legendary actions:
Baphomet has 3 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn and cannot spend them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he cannot spend any until his first turn ends.
Heartcleaver Attack (1 action). Make one Heartcleaver attack.
Charge (2 actions). Move up to Baphomet's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make one Gore attack.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, Baphomet can take one of these actions. He cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. Using an option requires being in the lair and able to act. If surprised, the creature must finish its first turn before using one.
Illusory Room. Cast Mirage Arcane in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension. Use Charisma. The illusion ends at the next initiative count 20.
Reverse Gravity. Reverse gravity in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension, until the next initiative count 20. Creatures and objects in the room fall in the new direction unless they can stay aloft. Baphomet can ignore the reversal.
Seal the Way. Fill an unoccupied doorway or other opening in the lair with solid stone. The stone lasts 1 minute or until Baphomet uses this option again.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects for the area around the lair.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Hedge Mazes. Vegetation within 1 mile forms dense barriers around small mazes.
Panicked Beasts. Beasts within 1 mile are frightened and disoriented. They may panic or lash out even without a visible threat.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Baphomet dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 58.

statBlock.name: Bard
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A performer who fights with sword or bow and uses magic to scatter enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow. Spellcasting can replace one of those attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Cacophony (Recharge 4–6). Every creature in a 15-ft. cube originating from the bard makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the bard. On a success, it takes half the damage and stays in place.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Charm Person, Invisibility, Sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Taunt (2/day). Choose one creature within 30 ft. If it can hear the bard, it makes a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 59.

statBlock.name: Barghest
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A soul-eating fiend that can pass as a goblin.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Fire Banishment. If the barghest starts its turn engulfed in flames at least 10 ft. high or wide, it makes a DC 15 Charisma save. Failure instantly returns it to Gehenna.
Soul Feeding. The barghest can spend at least 1 minute eating the corpse of a Fey or Humanoid it killed within the past 10 minutes. This destroys the corpse and traps the soul inside the barghest for 24 hours. Magic that tries to restore the victim to life while the soul is trapped has a 50 percent chance to fail and is wasted on a failure. If the barghest dies before the 24 hours end, the soul escapes. Otherwise, the barghest digests the soul and the victim cannot be revived.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12). Material components are waived.
At will. Levitate, Minor Illusion, Pass without Trace.
1/day each. Charm Person, Dimension Door, Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Small goblin or return to true form. Only size and speed change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form. The barghest returns to its true form if it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 60.

statBlock.name: Berbalang
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A winged creature that questions the dead and sends a psychic double into danger.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) psychic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence. Material components are waived.
At will. Speak with Dead.
1/day. Plane Shift, self only.
sections.Bonus actions: Spectral Duplicate (Recharges after a short or long rest). Create one duplicate in a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft. The berbalang remains unconscious while the duplicate exists, and it can have only one at a time. The duplicate disappears if either one drops to 0 hit points or if the berbalang dismisses it, which takes no action. The duplicate shares the berbalang's statistics and knowledge. The berbalang knows what the duplicate experiences. All damage from the duplicate's attacks is psychic.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 61.

statBlock.name: Bheur Hag
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A winter hag who rides a flying staff and can turn a grisly feast into a weapon.

sections.Traits:
Control Weather (1/day). Cast Control Weather using Charisma and without material components.
Graystaff Magic. The hag can use her flying speed only while riding her magical graystaff. Only a bheur hag can use the staff. If it is lost or destroyed, she must make another, which takes a year and a day.
Ice Walk. The hag can move and climb across ice without an ability check. Difficult terrain caused by ice or snow costs her no extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Slam or Frost Shard.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 18 (4d8) cold damage.
Frost Shard. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (6d8 + 3) cold damage and reduces the target's speed by 10 ft. until the start of the hag's next turn.
Horrific Feast. Feed on the corpse of an enemy within reach that died within the last minute. Choose any creatures within 60 ft. that can see the hag feeding. Each makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or becomes frightened of the hag for 1 minute. While frightened this way, the creature is incapacitated, cannot read or understand others' speech, and can speak only gibberish. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If it succeeds on a save or the effect ends, it is immune to this hag's Horrific Feast for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
While holding or riding the graystaff, cast one listed spell as an action using Charisma (spell save DC 14). Material components are waived.
At will. Hold Person.
1/day each. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm, Wall of Ice.
sections.Coven challenge: CR 9 (5,000 XP) when part of a coven.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 62.

statBlock.name: Black Abishai
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A shadow-hunting devil that fights inside a pool of darkness it can reposition.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The abishai's darkvision works in magical darkness.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Scimitar attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage.
Creeping Darkness (Recharge 6). Cast Darkness at a point within 120 ft. using Wisdom. The spell requires neither components nor concentration. While it lasts, the abishai can move the area of darkness up to 60 ft. as a bonus action.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 38.
